source_text: Neonatal male circumcision reduces the incidence of urinary tract infections (UTIs) in the first year of life by approximately 90%, based on a meta-analysis of one randomized trial and 11 observational studies, with absolute risk reduction from about 1% in uncircumcised infants to 0.1% in circumcised ones. [76]
